Smoke test: load baml and parse a simple snippet

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"baml\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("class Person {\n  name string\n  age int\n}\n\nenum Level {\n  Junior\n  Senior\n}\n\nfunction Greet(p: Person) -> string {\n  p.name\n}\n", config)
    println(result)
}
```
